accepted_source_types.evidence_level_after_review: L5 if source authenticity and permission are sufficient
L5 for commercial signal only within the recorded scope

minimum_fields: accepting actor or redacted actor class
accepted_source_types.evidence_level_after_review: L5 for delivery acceptance only within the accepted scope

accepted_source_types.source_type: platform, production, or usage telemetry excerpt
accepted_source_types.evidence_level_after_review: L5 for observed usage only when source and denominator are adequate

ingestion_flow: Human owner supplies a source record or authorizes a bounded source review.
Reality Agent classifies the source type and redaction requirement.
Evidence Agent maps the claim to L0-L5 and records limitations.
Policy Agent confirms whether A6 authorization is required before any external action.
Reviewer Agent rejects claims that exceed source scope.
Operator Agent updates backlog, evidence ledger, and checkpoint only after source review.

evidence_mapping.allowed_wording: feedback record received for the stated scope
evidence_mapping.forbidden_wording: customer validation or market proof without repeated source records

evidence_mapping.allowed_wording: paid or committed signal exists for the recorded scope
evidence_mapping.forbidden_wording: commercial validation or product-market fit from one record

evidence_mapping.allowed_wording: delivery accepted for the named artifact and scope
evidence_mapping.forbidden_wording: repeatable delivery system proven without repeated acceptance records

evidence_mapping.required_source: platform, production, or usage telemetry excerpt
evidence_mapping.allowed_wording: usage observed for the defined metric and window
evidence_mapping.forbidden_wording: production readiness, retention, or adoption proof without adequate denominator

redaction_rules: Do not store direct personal contact details in AOOS public records.
Do not store payment identifiers, account secrets, tokens, or credentials.
Use redacted actor classes when permission for named attribution is absent.
Keep raw source records outside public repository paths unless explicitly approved.
Record limitations when only summarized or redacted source evidence is available.
forbidden_actions: contacting users, customers, auditors, partners, or communities
publishing customer, payment, or private platform data
claiming real-world validation from this proposal packet
rollback_path: remove or revise this proposal packet if it blurs the A5/A6 boundary, stores private source data, or implies real-world execution.
